queryScope: Original complete 2463-base CDS interval, code 11, minimum 820 residues

result.displayOrder: first 200 in strand/frame/terminal-stop discovery order; not ranked
result.coordinateConvention: Window coordinates are 1-based inclusive on its forward DNA. Strand and frame refer to this supplied window, not the absolute assembly frame. Genomic end may be unrolled across an explicitly circular origin.

metadata.organism: Escherichia coli str. K-12 substr. MG1655
metadata.source: NCBI RefSeq ASM584v2 GFF3 and NCBI EFetch FASTA; public reference imported 2026-10-28

result.scope: Complete start-to-stop ORFs in six frames of this supplied window, using recorded Biopython codon tables. Every eligible nested start is counted; partial boundary ORFs are not reported. This is sequence enumeration, not gene prediction, expression, protein-function or essentiality evidence. No ORF is designed or optimized.

limitation: Coordinate/codon enumeration agrees with this reference CDS; no novel gene or biological activity predicted.
